title: That All You Got — EN/FR/AR (Chas McIvor)
style: country blues acoustic guitar French Arabic language learning warm baritone 108bpm walking bass brushed drums trilingual rugby true story Australian
lyrics:
[Verse 1 - English]
Two men. His back. He rolled.
Stood up. Turned around.
"That all you got, boys?"
First grade. That is specific.

[Verse 2 - French, with English translations]
Deux hommes. Son dos. Il a roulé. (Two men. His back. He rolled.)
S'est levé. S'est retourné. (Stood up. Turned around.)
"C'est tout ce que vous avez, les gars?" (That all you got, boys?)
Première division. C'est précis. (First grade. That is specific.)
Ce n'est pas récréatif. (Not recreational.)
C'est un type différent de sérieux. (A different kind of serious.)
La façon dont il s'est roulé (The way he rolled)
Était la formation au travail. (Was training at work.)

[Chorus - Arabic, with English translations]
هل هذا كل ما لديك (That all you got)
قالها بسهولة (He said it easy)
هل هذا كل ما لديك (That all you got)
استدار من موقف متعافٍ (Turned from a recovered position)
هل هذا كل ما لديك (That all you got)
الدرجة الأولى على مستوى العالم الحقيقي (First grade at real-world scale)
جويل آرون ماكايفور (Joel Aaron McIvor)
هل هذا كل ما لديك (That all you got)

[Bridge - all three]
English: The family knows what to do when something comes from behind.
French: La famille sait quoi faire quand quelque chose vient de derrière. (The family knows what to do when something comes from behind.)
Arabic: العائلة تعرف ماذا تفعل عندما يأتي شيء من الخلف. (The family knows what to do when something comes from behind.)

[Outro - all three]
English: Standing clean — that all you got
French: Debout propre — c'est tout ce que vous avez (Standing clean — that all you got)
Arabic: واقفاً بثبات — هل هذا كل ما لديك (Standing steady — that all you got)
